name: Extra Tail
body:
You have grown another tail.

Prerequisite: Fox-blooded

Benefit: You gain one additional fox tail. In addition, you can choose one fox magic feat that you qualify for as a bonus feat.

Special: You can gain Extra Tail multiple times. Full-blooded kitsune cannot take this feat.
